blockers.description: gsd-planner Task() hit a stream idle timeout (~19 min wall-clock; tool_uses=45) after writing 1 of ~6 plans to disk. Cause: large prompt (~3,500 lines of context across CONTEXT/RESEARCH/PATTERNS) + sonnet model + ambitious 6-plan scope in a single agent invocation.
blockers.workaround: Switch to chunked planner mode (--chunked flag). Outline phase produces 07-PLAN-OUTLINE.md (~2 min), then per-plan Tasks (~3-5 min each, committed individually for crash resilience). Resume detection skips 07-01-PLAN.md if the YAML frontmatter is intact — which it is.

decisions.decision: Skip UI-SPEC for Phase 7 via --skip-ui flag
decisions.rationale: Regex hit on 'ui' inside the word 'reQUIrements' was a false positive. UI surfaces in P7 are extensions to existing P3 (HUD ring), P4 (chat panel), P6 (menu-bar toggle pattern), with two genuinely new small affordances (camera-icon button + confirmation thumbnail) explicitly granted to Claude's Discretion in CONTEXT.md. Matches Phase 6 precedent.

Phases 4 (Agent Core) and 6 (Voice) both planned without AI-SPEC. Continuing the convention. Phase 7's AI work (qwen2.5-coder extractor, nomic-embed-text embeddings, Gemma 4 / Qwen 3.5 / Opus vision routing) is fully specified in CONTEXT.md D-01..D-18.

07-RESEARCH.md does not have a `## Validation Architecture` section header (only Phase 1 had one). Per workflow §5.5 the absence triggers warn-and-continue. Phase 6 followed the same path. Plans must embed test commands directly to satisfy Dimension 8.

decisions.decision: Use --chunked on resume instead of monolithic planner
decisions.rationale: The single Task() invocation timed out at tool_uses=45 with only 1/6 plans written. Chunked mode bounds each subagent to 3-5 min and commits per-plan, surviving any future timeouts. Plan 07-01 will be skipped on resume (frontmatter intact = treated as completed work).

next_action: Resume with `/gsd-plan-phase 7 --skip-ui --chunked`. The chunked planner spawns an outline Task first (~2 min) then per-plan Tasks (~3-5 min each). Resume detection will skip 07-01-PLAN.md (already on disk with valid frontmatter) and pick up from 07-02 onward.
